name: Kaminuma Kiriko
source:
Kiriko is one of Hideaki's classmates. She likes to be alone and has a cool type of personality. She does have some friends at school, but she is basically alone most of the time. Kiriko enjoys photography, and often carries around her camera. Her grandfather owns a watch store which she lives above and works at as a part time job.

[edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orange_Pocket]Wikipedia[/url]]
